quote: Courage is indispensable because in politics not life but the world is at stake.
source: Hannah Arendt, Between Past and Future, What Is Freedom?, section II, p. 156 (Viking, 1961)
note: Corrected: the section can be pinned after all. The sentence closes section II of What Is Freedom? on p. 156 of the Viking edition of 1961, where it follows the claim that courage frees people from their worry about life for the freedom of the world.
